federation.title: Federation peers
federation.intro: Trusted artist-alley instances this install will exchange activities with. Pairing alone shares no content until you explicitly share something.
federation.banner_no_content_yet: Adding a peer here creates a trusted communication channel. No posts, collections, assets, or other content actually flows until you (or another user with permission) explicitly shares an object with the peer — object sharing arrives in a future release.
federation.add_help: Manual entry — paste the peer's instance URL, display name, and PEM-encoded Ed25519 instance public key (coordinated out-of-band with the peer's operator). An automated handshake will arrive in a future release.
federation.confirm_defederate: Defederate {name}? This removes the peer + cascades to any share grants once object sharing ships.
federation.cascade_intro: You're about to defederate {url}. Review the impact below before continuing.
federation.cascade_preview_error: Couldn't load the cascade preview. Try again before defederating.
federation.cascade_delete_error: Defederate failed. The peer is still paired; try again or check the server log.
federation.cascade_cached_suggestions: cached peer-of-peer suggestion(s) will be dropped
federation.cascade_aa_unshare_note: A final aa:Unshare activity will be queued for each revoked share (best-effort delivery to the peer's inbox).
federation.cascade_irreversible_note: This action cannot be undone except by re-pairing and re-granting each share.

shares.title: Federation shares
shares.intro: Active per-object grants. Pairing alone shares nothing; every row here is an explicit grantor decision.
shares.load_error: Couldn't load shares. Check the filter values and try again.
shares.bad_grantor: Grantor must be a positive integer user ref.
shares.empty: No active shares for this filter.
shares.confirm_revoke: Revoke share {id}…? Emits aa:Unshare; recipient drops cached bytes but keeps their own derivative work.
shares.revoke_error: Revoke failed. The share is still active; try again or check the server log.

federation.empty: No peers paired yet. Add one above to start federating.
federation.this_url_unset: (not configured — set site base URL in System → Site)
federation.this_help: Share these values out-of-band with peer operators so they can verify the handshake before accepting.
federation.pending_inbound_help: Other instances have asked to pair with you. Review the fingerprint out-of-band before accepting — pairing creates a trusted channel.
federation.confirm_reject: Reject pending request from {name}? Their offer will be discarded.
federation.pair_help: Enter the peer's instance URL. We'll send a signed handshake offer; the peer's admin must accept on their side before pairing completes.
federation.manual_help: Advanced: paste the peer's URL + their Ed25519 instance public key (coordinated out-of-band). Lands as connected immediately. Use when automated handshake isn't possible (air-gapped, DNS-less, etc.).
federation.form_display_name_optional: Display name (optional — defaults to URL host)
federation.col_share_help: When enabled, this peer appears in our public /federation/peers/visible response, letting other peers surface it as a discovery suggestion.
federation.suggestions_help: Peers your peers federate with that you don't. Each suggestion shows which of your peers contributed it. Pairing still goes through the handshake.
federation.suggestions_empty: No suggestions yet. Click "Refresh suggestions" or wait for the next scheduled poll.
federation.dir_intro: Subscribe to directories of artist-alley instances to discover potential peers. Pairing still requires the per-peer handshake — directories are advisory.
federation.dir_banner: Subscribing to a directory only fetches its list of instances. No content flows + no pairings are created automatically. You still click 'Pair' on each entry you want to federate with.
federation.dir_subscribe_help: Enter the directory's base URL. We'll fetch the operator's public key fingerprint — review it out-of-band before relying on the directory's listings.
federation.dir_empty: No directories subscribed yet. Subscribe to one above to discover peers.
federation.dir_confirm_unsubscribe: Unsubscribe from {name}? Cached entries will be removed.
federation.dir_entries_help: Cached listings. Click 'Pair' to start the handshake with one — directory entries are advisory only; trust is established by the handshake itself.
federation.dir_entries_empty: This directory has no cached entries. Try polling now.
federation.dir_publish_listed_banner: This instance is published to the directory (listing_id: {id}).
federation.dir_publish_dns_instructions: Add the following TXT record to your DNS, then come back and click "Register listing" — the directory will verify the record before accepting your listing.
federation.dir_publish_tags_help: Up to 20 tags. Used by other admins to filter the directory.

fields.title: Fields & metadata
fields.label: Label
fields.create_help_subject: Pick where this field shows up. An asset field hangs off individual assets; a collection field hangs off whole collections.
fields.create_help_required: Required collection fields must be supplied at collection creation time.
fields.description_help: Shown to whoever fills this field in. Say what belongs here, not what the field is called.
fields.advanced_help: Where this field sits in a form, and what it applies to. Safe to ignore until you have more fields than fit on one screen.
fields.display_help: Fields are grouped by name and sorted by order within a group, lowest first. Both are hints — a surface may ignore them.
fields.applies_to_help: Only the asset types ticked below.
fields.applies_to_none: No asset types are defined on this instance yet.
fields.capability_readonly_help: Capabilities decide who can see and change this field's values. They are shown here but not edited here — changing who can read a field is an access decision, not a layout one.
fields.options_help: Options are never deleted — an asset may already store one. Deprecate a term to stop offering it while assets that have it keep working; archive it to retire it outright.
fields.options_none: No options yet. Add one below.
fields.options_add_unslugabble: That term has no storable form — use some letters or numbers.
fields.options_add_label_taken: "{label}" is already the name of another term ({slug}). You can still add this one, but a value typed as that name will always resolve to the first.
fields.options_tree_help: Terms nest. A term keeps working wherever you move it — assets store the term itself, not its position — so relabelling and re-nesting never touch what is already catalogued.
fields.options_duplicate: "{slug}" is already an option of this field.
fields.options_type_note: A {type} field has no option list.
fields.options_conflict_body: Your changes were not saved. Reload to see theirs, or save again to overwrite them.
fields.default_help: What this field is filled with when an asset is created and nobody has said otherwise. Extraction from the file still wins, and anything the uploader types wins over both.
fields.default_context_help: The server fills this in at upload time. The list is fixed — there is no formula box, deliberately.
fields.default_no_terms: This field has no options to pick from yet. Add some under Edit first.
fields.default_incomplete: Pick a value, or switch to "No default".
fields.default_overrides_help: A team can use a different default for its own uploads. Overrides stay on this instance — they are not shared with peers the way the field itself is.
fields.default_override_add_help: The override uses whatever value is selected above.
fields.default_override_needs_value: Pick a value above before adding an override.
fields.show_on_card_help: Render this field at a glance on asset cards in browse and grids. A card falls back to the upload date when nothing is chosen.
fields.show_on_card_gated: This field has a read capability, so it cannot be shown on cards — a card renders on browse, where per-field capabilities have not been checked.
fields.open_vocabulary_help: A value naming a term this field doesn't have creates it instead of being refused. Matching is case-insensitive on the slug or the label, so “Sunset” and “sunset” stay one term.

field_detail.not_found: No field with the code “{code}” — it may have been renamed or never existed.
field_detail.mirror_heading: This field is a view onto the asset's “{column}”
field_detail.mirror_body: It has no storage of its own: reading it reads the asset's {column}, and writing it writes the asset's {column}. That is why the two can never disagree, and why this field holds no values of its own you could edit or export separately.
field_detail.mirror_auth: Changing a value through this field is changing the asset, so it needs the same permission editing the asset would — being signed in is not enough.
field_detail.mirror_readonly: Which columns can be mirrored is fixed by the database, not by this page — there is no control here because there is no way to point a field at a different column without a schema change.
field_detail.extraction_help: Where this field's value comes from when a file carries one. Leave the source empty to keep the field entirely operator-managed.
field_detail.lifecycle_help: Fields are archived, never deleted: archiving hides a field from the live schema and leaves every value assets already hold intact and readable.

license.title: License status
license.intro: What this install's verifier sees. Reads /etc/artist-alley/license.lic at boot; when no file is present, runs in community mode with the built-in defaults.
license.community_explainer: No license file is installed. The app is using its built-in community defaults — full feature set capped at 15 seats and 20,000 primary assets. Drop a paid .lic at /etc/artist-alley/license.lic + restart to upgrade.
license.install_explainer: Paste the contents of a .lic file the issuer sent you. The verifier checks the signature + dates before anything is written to disk. Validate runs the same check without persisting.
license.validate_error_unknown: Validation failed for an unknown reason. Check server logs.
license.install_error_unknown: Installation failed for an unknown reason. Check server logs.
license.validate_code_bad_envelope: The envelope text is malformed — markers, fields, or signature line are missing or out of order.
license.validate_code_bad_signature: Signature verification failed. The file was modified after issuance, or the issuer's signing key isn't trusted by this build.
license.validate_code_not_yet_valid: This license is not yet valid (the not-before date is in the future).
license.validate_code_unknown_publisher_key: The signing key id isn't in this build's trusted catalog. The license was signed by a publisher this binary doesn't recognise.
license.validate_code_wrong_issuer: The issuer string in the envelope doesn't match the canonical authority this build expects.
license.validate_code_chain_expired: The publisher certificate that signed this license has expired.
license.validate_code_chain_bad_signature: The publisher certificate's signature is invalid.
license.validate_code_chain_scope: The publisher certificate doesn't allow signing this product.
license.validate_code_chain_kid_mismatch: The signing-key id on the license doesn't match the publisher certificate.
license.validate_code_org_key_missing: This license requires customer activation but no org.key file was found on the server. Run customer-activation to generate one, then request a license re-issuance against the new public key.
license.validate_code_org_key_bad_format: The org.key file on disk is malformed — expected a base64-encoded 32-byte Ed25519 seed.
license.validate_code_org_key_mismatch: The org.key on disk doesn't match this license. Either install the org.key the license was issued against, or request a re-issuance with the org.key currently in place.
license.validate_code_unknown: Validation failed for an unknown reason.
license.enterprise_gates_explainer: Cross-references the license feature list against the live identity-provider registry + tenancy manager. Green dot = both licensed AND wired up in this binary. Amber dot = feature is licensed but the corresponding subsystem isn't registered (binary likely predates the license — restart after upgrade). Grey dot = feature not in the license.
license.org_binding_explainer: This license is bound to an org.key file the customer holds. The verifier re-checks the public key derived from org.key against the license at boot and on every upload. A stolen .lic without the matching org.key cannot activate.
license.org_binding_recovery_hint: Recovery: copy the original org.key into place (file permissions 0600), or run scripts/customer-activation in the license-server repo to generate a new one and request a license re-issuance against the new public key.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Every key the app listens for, grouped by where it works. There is no global shortcut — each set applies only while that surface is open, and none of them fire while you're typing in a text field.

note.viewer_nav: Left and right move between posts only when you opened the asset from a feed or collection, and only on assets that don't use them for something else — a video steps frames instead, an ebook turns pages. Up and down always move within the post.
note.playback: Only on video and audio. Left and right step frames as well, and on a video they no longer also jump to the next post — the player has the arrows while it is open.
note.ebook: The reader has the arrows while it is open, so they turn pages instead of moving to the next post.
note.document: Available while the Document panel is open. With it closed, Ctrl/⌘ F is your browser's own find.
note.whiteboard_edit: While the whiteboard is open its keys win: F fits the drawing instead of going fullscreen.

federation.not_supported_headline: Encrypted federation is not yet supported.
federation.page_body: Activities that target restricted or embargo sensitivity objects will not federate to peers until encrypted delivery ships in a future release. The share records you grant today are persisted, so when encrypted federation ships those backlogged activities will federate automatically — but until then, expect zero outbound federation for sensitive objects.
federation.grant_headline: This object is marked {sensitivity} — encrypted federation is not yet supported.
federation.grant_body: Sharing now will create the share record but no activities will federate until encrypted delivery ships in a future release. You can:
federation.opt_share_anyway: Share anyway, knowing activity federation is paused for this object until encrypted delivery ships; or
federation.opt_cancel: Cancel and downgrade the object’s sensitivity to a non-restricted tier first.
